proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: Full review 2026-11-21. lean.ref is still QOU.WedderburnMass.atomicMass, a def (wedderburn-mass-formula.lean:56-60) that writes the formula Z m_p + N m_n + Z m_e + alpha(Phi1 + beta2 Phi2 + beta3 Phi3) as a definition over free fields of ThreeInvariants / MassParams; a theorem block whose ref is a definition does not prove that the atomic mass equals this. Phi1, Phi2, Phi3 are free ring elements with no transfer matrix M_i, no ln, no z; beta3 is a free field, not h_A^2. Improved: the md now limits the three-block claim to n <= 3, and that restriction is proved (extremal_exhausts_iff_n_le_three, non_extremal_irreps_at_n_eq_four, adjacentChain_twice_lt_allPairs_twice, all by decide/omega on lookup tables partitionCountLow/extremalIrrepCount, i.e. counts not representation theory), and the dependency 2 beta3 + beta2 + 6 = 0 is proved as QOU.Mass.WedderburnMassFormulaCoefficients.beta3_of_beta2. Remains: the central identity is unproved; the Lean module header still says 'These are complete: no fourth invariant exists' (lean:8-9), contradicting md:46-50; md:62 'zero fitted parameters' while m_p and m_n are free inputs (MassParams fields); and the absolute-mass target m(Z,N) in MeV is excised by owner ruling 2026-08-11. No conflict with the photon/electron/quark rulings.
